species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 44°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 2–12 ft deep, mostly on flats.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Northeast wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the southwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
